{{ds:component/alert|variant=warning|title=Upcoming breaking change|body_html=

A breaking change is coming in the next major SDK release. Please review your integrations and upcoming release notes before upgrading.

A thin, typed wrapper around the v2 REST API for Node.js and TypeScript projects.

Install

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=npm install @godzilla/sdk}}

Create a client

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=client.ts|language=typescript|code=import { Godzilla } from "@godzilla/sdk"; const godzilla = new Godzilla({ apiKey: process.env.GODZILLA_API_KEY });}}

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-pipeline.ts|language=typescript|code=const pipeline = await godzilla.pipelines.create({ name: "ingest-orders", sourceConnectorId: "conn_pg_orders", destinationConnectorId: "conn_snowflake_dw", });}}

Listening for webhooks

The SDK includes a signature-verification helper for webhook payloads:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=verify.ts|language=typescript|code=import { verifyWebhookSignature } from "@godzilla/sdk"; const isValid = verifyWebhookSignature(rawBody, signatureHeader, webhookSecret);}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Retries are built in|body_html=

The SDK retries idempotent requests (GET, and POST with an Idempotency-Key) automatically on 429 and 5xx responses using the same backoff the API itself uses.

}}
